title: Clover Valley: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: Rosie heard a tiny voice in the meadow.
The little houses were made from acorns, walnut shells, and stones.
To the tiny people, Rosie was as big as a tree.
In the village, a ladybug delivered the mail.
Rosie held a big leaf over the village like an umbrella.
The party for Rosie was in the morning.
What was hidden under the clover flowers?
items.why: “There, hidden under the flowers, was a tiny village!”
“There was a bakery inside a teapot, a school under a leaf roof, and a bridge made of twigs.”

items.q: What would each raindrop be like for the little people?
items.why: “But to the little people, each raindrop would be huge.”

items.q: What did Rosie use to block the rushing water?
items.why: “Then she used twigs and pebbles to block the rushing water.”

items.q: What did the little people give Rosie her tea in?
items.why: “They gave her tea in a shiny acorn cup.”

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Rosie Rabbit found a tiny village of little people hidden under the clover flowers. When a storm came, she held a big leaf over the village and helped the little people keep it safe. They became friends, and the little people held a party for her.

items.q: Why did the tiny people run and hide when they saw Rosie?
items.model: To them, Rosie was as big as a hill. They were afraid she would step on their village.

items.q: How did Rosie help during the storm?
items.model: She held a big leaf over the village like an umbrella. She used twigs and pebbles to block the rushing water.

items.q: What did the little people do at the party?
items.model: They gave Rosie tea in a shiny acorn cup and served berry cake, honey crumbs and flower jam. Music filled the meadow.

items.q: Have you ever helped a friend with a big problem? What did you do?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: Rosie heard a tiny voice in the meadow
Clover asked Rosie not to step on the village
Clover showed Rosie around the village
Rosie held a big leaf over the village
The little people held a party for Rosie
